description: Confirm a planned quiz rollout (registry op project_todos.quizzes.rollout.confirm). Takes plan.token from opentrain_plan_quiz_rollout, the EXACT same todo the plan reviewed (the token signs its digest; a different todo is 409 PLAN_TODO_MISMATCH) and a STABLE idempotencyKey. Before any write it re-checks that Project To-dos are still enabled and that the live roster equals the planned recipient set; then it publishes the planned draft (or binds the planned version), creates the Project To-do, and assigns the roster — each step idempotent under the key, so a retry with the SAME key converges on the same ids (replayed: true) and never double-publishes or double-assigns, and the same plan cannot be confirmed under a second key (409 TARGET_ALREADY_MUTATED). Any drift since the plan fails closed as 409 PLAN_STALE with details.changed (roster | projectTodosEnabled | draftRevision | content | archived | job | form) and nothing written; if the refusal happens after this rollout’s own publication, details.published names the version and the receipt is kept so a retry with the SAME key resumes it (or plan again with source VERSION). An expired or foreign token is 409 PLAN_TOKEN_EXPIRED / PLAN_TOKEN_INVALID — plan again, never retry blindly. An exact duplicate of an active To-Do is refused unless allowDuplicate: true. Requires project_todos:write.
name: opentrain_confirm_quiz_rollout
